summary: Fase 1C 'Ontbrekende prijzen aanvullen' / zelflerende offertegenerator fully tested. 5/5 backend pytest cases pass, all 6 frontend acceptance criteria verified end-to-end including persistence to werkpost library. Found 1 pre-existing backend bug (GET /api/werkposten?search=... returns 500) that is unrelated to this iteration but should be fixed.

minor.issue: Returns 500 OperationFailure '$or/$and/$nor entries need to be full objects'. The search-filter query construction in werkposten.py (lines 178-189) wraps the existing $or list as an $and entry which is invalid Mongo syntax. Frontend Werkposten page does client-side filtering so production UX is not affected, but the public API contract is broken.

action_items: (Optional) Fix GET /api/werkposten?search query construction in /app/backend/werkposten.py (lines 178-189). Suggested fix: drop the broken conditional pop logic and build a clean $and list, e.g. and_clauses = []; if not include_inactive: and_clauses.append({'$or':[{'active':{'$ne':False}},{'active':{'$exists':False}}]}); if search: and_clauses.append({'$or':[{'name':{'$regex':search,'$options':'i'}},{'title':{'$regex':search,'$options':'i'}}]}); query = {'$and':and_clauses} if and_clauses else {}

(Optional) When the offerte-generator suggest endpoint pre-fills prices from the library (zelflerend), the row is no longer 'wasMissing' so the 'Ontbrekende prijzen' block hides it — verify this is the intended UX (currently it is, and works fine).
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing bug: list_werkposten search filter constructs an invalid Mongo $and query. The expression `query.pop('$or', {'$or': [{}]}) if '$or' in query else {}` evaluates to the LIST (e.g. [{'active':{'$ne':False}}, ...]) when $or exists, and Mongo rejects bare arrays inside $and. Trigger: GET /api/werkposten?search=anything with default include_inactive=false.

offerte_generator.py auto-create-werkpost block (lines 441-457) duplicates field-mapping logic that already lives in /werkposten/learn-price. Consider DRYing by calling learn-price internally instead of importing WorkItem + DISCIPLINE_ORDER directly.

OfferteGeneratorModal.js learnPrice() does not refresh data afterwards — if the user adds a price, then closes & reopens the modal, the suggest endpoint will repopulate from library and skip rendering of that row. Current behavior works, just worth noting for future template edits.

New backend bug to watch: GET /api/werkposten?search=... currently 500s; list+client-filter as a workaround.
rca of the issue: GET /api/werkposten search-filter bug RCA: in werkposten.py list_werkposten, when search is provided AND include_inactive is false, the code attempts: query['$and']=[query.pop('$or', {'$or':[{}]}) if '$or' in query else {}, {'$or':[...search...]}]. The first element evaluates to the previously-set list value of query['$or'] (a Python list of full objects). Mongo's $and operator requires each entry to itself be an object expression, not an array. Resolution: rebuild the query as $and of two $or sub-objects (see action_items code snippet). Reproduction: curl '$BASE/api/werkposten?search=x' → 500. Not blocking iteration since UI uses client-side filter.
